title: Executive Assistant – AI Experience
description:
We are on the lookout for a Personal Assistant or Executive Assistant to take on an exciting new role with a large, fast-paced company based in Solihull.

This is a great opportunity to support two Managing Directors who are responsible for the overall strategy and operations of the business.

In this role, you will provide exceptional PA support, build relationships with stakeholders at all levels of the organisation, and arrange international travel.

However, this is not just a standard PA role. We are looking for someone who is confident using AI tools and can identify ways to use them effectively to improve day-to-day productivity, streamline tasks and enhance efficiency across the business.

The role will also include diary management, responding to correspondence, and prioritising tasks effectively.

For this position, we are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant or PA who is used to working in a large organisation and a fast-paced environment. Experience using AI tools or providing senior-level support would also be advantageous. This is a fully office based role based in Solihull.

We are shortlisting candidates for this role, so please apply now! Alternatively, call Kieran at Katie Bard on for more information.
